Why zone 1, and why solo:
- In zone 0, the three of us (me + drivers 1,2,4) would split the full 6×10 = 60 pool across 4 drivers → only 15 each, plus on the long run I don't want to cap others out of the best jobs, but 15 is the worst realistic outcome.
- Zone 1 with me alone: 5 riders vs my 4-seat capacity → price is 10 + 5×(5−4) = 15. Four of the five ride (one refuses given a cap below 15), so I take 4×15 = 60 solo. That beats 35/35 in zone 1 if driver_4 joins me (4 riders can ride at base 10 only with two of us → 25 each), and 20/20 if I were in a three-driver zone-1... and certainly beats zone 2 (max ~30 with 3 riders at 10) and offline (0).

If driver_4 surprises and joins me in zone 1, we still end at 25 each — the big downside I accept, because that requires him to abandon the zone-0 trio's 35/35 each... no, wait: if he moves to zone 1 I'm down to 25, but the cluster then has only drivers 1+2 in zone 0 → each 30, and the zone-1 ride is captured elsewhere. Either way I look at zone 0 vs zone 1: solo in zone 1 at 60 dominates every zone-0 outcome available to me. Go with zone 1, expect others to hold zone 0.
